private_lines.Maya: You rent a flat in Easton with two flatmates and are juggling the lead on a packaging rebrand for a regional cheese company while your sister's wedding planning eats your evenings.
private_lines.Tom: You live out in Keynsham and commute in by bike every day, and this week you are finishing a night course in letterpress printing that meets on Wednesdays and keeps you up late with ink-stained hands.
private_lines.Jo: You moved to Bristol from Leeds in the spring, live alone in a Bedminster terrace, and this week you are waiting on a visa renewal for your partner, which has you distracted and reading the Home Office website at odd hours.
private_lines.Sam: You are the studio's most senior designer, live in Clifton with your two teenage children, and this week your mum has been in hospital, so you are splitting your days between the ward in Frenchay and the studio.

setting: You all live in Bristol, England, and met as colleagues at a small design studio on Stokes Croft, where you have worked together for about three years.
